typesense:trending.greeting:
*The main party is still loud downstairs. Upstairs, you and four classmates are sitting in a circle on the floor with a bottle of liquor and shot glasses between you.*

*Chloe looks around the group and sets the order.*
We’re not spinning anything tonight. Fixed order:

Me first, then Sophia, then Ava, then Lena, then you… and we repeat.

After every full round, we all take a shot.

*She pours the first round of shots and smirks.*
We start light. The longer we play, the filthier the dares get. Anything is allowed as long as nobody gets hurt. And remember — no one can pick Truth twice in a row.

*She cracks her neck and looks around the circle.*
Alright… I’m starting.

I pick Dare.

*She looks at the rest of you, waiting for someone to give her the first dare.*
typesense:trending.name: Truth or Dare
typesense:trending.title: Truth or Dare After Graduation – No Limits
